IS : 9940 - 1981 

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
TRIMMERS, ELECTRICALLY OPERATED, 
FOR DENTAL MODELS 

0. FOREWORD 

0.1 This Indian Standard was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution 
on 16 September 1981, after the draft finalized by the Dental Equipment 
Sectional Committee had been approved by the Consumer Products & 
Medical Instruments Division Council. 

0.2 Model trimmers are used extensively by the dentists for trimming by 
grinding the dental models and to bring them into desired shape. This 
standard covers functional requirements and is expected to help in providing 
equipment of uniform quality. 

0,3 This standard contains 4.1 which calls for agreement between the 
purchaser and the supplier. 



1. SCOPE 

1.1 This standard covers the requirements for model trimmers used in 
dentistry. 

2. TERMINOLOGY 

2.0 For the purpose of this standard, the following definition shall apply. 

2.1 Model Trimmer — A motor-operated grinding stone capable of remov- 
ing excess plaster and trimming by grinding the dental models and to bring 
them into desired shape. 

3. REQUIREMENTS 

3.1 The electric motor shall be capable of delivering an output of 180, 250 
or 370 watts with a minimum speed of 1 350 rev/min. The motor shall be of 
capacitor-start induction-run type and shall conform to IS : 996-1979*. The 
enclosure shall be of totally enclosed fan cooled type. 



* Specification for single-phase small ac and universal electric motors ( second 
revision ). 



IS : 9940 - 1981 

3.2 A well balanced rough circular grinding stone of diameter 300 mm shall 
be fixed on the right-hand side of the platform used for supporting the 
model for trimming. 

3.3 The grinding stone shall be enclosed in a split cast-iron or aluminium 
cover of diameter 330 mm. The cover shall have an opening only at the 
window. The split cover shall be suitably designed for easy operation to 
change the stone face or removal of stone. 

3.4 A platform to support the model and press the same against the stone 
shall be provided. The platform on the trimmer shall be adjustable to any 
position near the wheel. 

3.5 The platform shall be fitted by means of a thumb nut and shall be 
removable when required for cleaning and washing operations. 

3.6 The details of the platform and its fixing arrangement to the cover shall 
be as shown in Fig. 1. 

3.7 An arrangement shall be made as shown in Fig. 1 for directing a strong 
jet of water against the stone face for washing down the plaster slurry and 
bits adhering to the stone. 

3.8 A draw pipe shall be fitted to the equipment to drain washed water 
containing plaster bits slurry. 

3.9 A thick backing plate of aluminium shall be fitted behind the stone to 
prevent the same from breaking under pressure. 

3.10 The motor and stone enclosure shall be mounted on a mild steel or 
aluminium base of suitable thickness. 

Note — The requirements of grinding stone shall be incorporated in due course. 

4. FINISH 

4.1 The complete unit shall be finished by painting with a water-proof hard 
enamel. The finish shall be smooth and the colour as agreed to between the 
supplier and the purchaser. 

5. MARKING 

5.1 Each model trimmer shall be marked with the name or registered trade 
mark of the manufacturer and the country of manufacture. 



GRINDING WHEEL* 
DIA 300 





FRONT COVER, OIA 330 

RUBBER WASHER 
BACK COVER, DIA 320 



PLATFOR! 



BASE 



RUBBER SHOE 



MOTOR 



HOLE, DIA 8 FOR 
WATER INLET 



PIPE, DIA 15 FOR 
WATER OUTLET 



All dimensions in millimetres. 
Fig. 1 Trimmer, Electrically Operated, for Dental Models

IS: 9940 -1981 

5.2 The model trimmers may also be marked with the ISI Certification 
Mark. 

Note — The use of the ISI Certification Mark is governed by the provisions of the 
Indian Standards Institution ( Certification Marks ) Act and the Rules and Regula- 
tions made thereunder. The ISI Mark on products covered by an Indian Standard 
conveys the assurance that they have been produced to comply with the requirements 
of that standard under a well-defined system of inspection, testing and quality control 
which is devised and supervised by ISI and operated by the producer. ISI marked 
products are also continuously checked by ISI for conformity to that standard as a 
further safeguard. Details of conditions under which a licence for the use of the ISI 
Certification Mark may be granted to manufacturers or processors, may be obtained 
from the Indian Standards Institution. 

6. PACKING 

6.1 Each model trimmer shall be packed to ensure safe delivery of the 
trimmer in a suitable casing with soft packing material like wood-wool.
